title: One navigation: sections as card grids, one filter bar, leaf pages without sidebars
description: The top bar is the kind filter (home = all); each section's front page is the card grid filtered to its kind; an item's page is only that item, full width, no left sidebar (works on phones). One filter bar everywhere: Top/Recent, time window with widening, Mine, search, per-section More filters (Clips' curation filters), + New. Search box in the top bar (filters a section; elsewhere a results page across kinds). The account pill moves into the top bar as a badge with a menu (in the hamburger on phones). Agreed with the user 2026-09-27.
